patches.purpose: 通用客户端挂载跟随 Loader 的插件替换状态：替换前同步卸载 React 根，完成激活后重新挂载，失败保留现有启动页面及插件诊断。相同且健康的插件图仅刷新模块索引，不触发页面重挂载；显式重试仍检查插件。覆盖 Session scope adapter 暂时卸载导致根永久白屏的问题，不修改产品协议或 Session 格式。

Electron profile resolution canonicalizes file-module URLs and lookup directories with archive-aware native realpath. Windows short paths and directory aliases share initial startup module instances; query strings and fragments remain distinct for HMR. Plain Node and packaged executable resolution retain their existing behavior. The real archived Electron regression exercises the built resolver and fails on duplicate identity when canonicalization is removed.

Preserve shipped Cordis preset IDs and Inspector event names in the generic vendor-rescope check. Only named files and the cordis token are exempted; other vendor package names remain checked. Regression fixtures cover preserved identifiers and continued package-name rewrites.

Keep the generic product-use gate aware of independent application assemblies while preserving the official profile boundary. Assembly runtime and source entries are checked separately, product roles are explicit, accidental default-profile mounts fail, and malformed or unknown assembly packages are rejected.

Generic trusted desktop lifecycle hooks, environment/profile overlays, namespaced bidirectional IPC, validated caller deadlines, sender checks, cancellation, credential-free structured failures, and teardown. Every renderer boot reads current Host index injections through correlated IPC with a bounded deadline and rejects Host replacement rather than reusing stale module revisions. Host startup canonicalizes the runtime with native realpath so entry imports and profile resolution share module identities, including Windows short paths. Archived runtimes resolve the archive file without requiring plain Node to traverse its virtual directories; a real archived Electron child exercises this path. No product protocol is embedded in Electron or Host. 普通退出清理期间合并重复退出请求，分别记录清理失败并等待其余资源停止后退出；更新策略先于认证资源释放。 启动准备钩子提供官方 profile 目录与安装锚点，让独立扩展使用公开 profile API 补充插件，不在官方壳中识别产品包。 原生欢迎及账户请求使用本次 Host 的认证 Cookie，不依赖 Chromium 累积的本机 Cookie；限定同一 authority，拒绝重定向。
通用 desktop assembly 提供运行时根、资源、图标、构建步骤及可选 builderConfig；产品打包策略通过独立配置接入，官方默认打包和签名配置保持原有行为。开发描述符保留受信扩展设置。

Typed detached Preset derivation retains Loader resolution context. A scoped asynchronous selection resolver lets extensions preserve composed capabilities, with turn-boundary checks before and after resolution. Selectable/defaultable flags hide execution snapshots from pickers and defaults. Generic selectionBase metadata associates hidden compositions with their selectable origin; the original mode controller and read-only label use it without changing Session execution identities. Unknown or unavailable compositions never display a default mode.
Generic sidebar panel headings and wide-row icon props allow additional grouped navigation through existing slots.
Retained generic HMR transport fix supports unavailable Node execution and WebSocket close/reconnect without narrowing to one desktop product.
Expose the official MCP public tool-name encoder and honor configured MCP request timeouts during connection and discovery so extensions can use the public client without product policy in Harness.

Retained generic packaging fixes explicitly install the declared Office engine, retry verified runtime downloads, cache Windows runtime dependencies, and boot the correct private Host from smoke tests.

Release integration supports explicit anonymous HTTPS update feeds, Gitea downloads with channel metadata, and an explicit mandatory-policy switch. Native update confirmation and signature checks remain unchanged.
Retained Windows installer qualification supports service-hosted headless runners and a separate explicit native-presentation probe.

Workspace integration registers private external-namespace packages, their compiler programs and public exports, and product assembly commands. Official runtime manifests and sources have no product dependency. Product build configuration stays package-local. Repository reference scanning distinguishes lockfile artifact byte counts from commit references while retaining checks for references on the same line. 产品协议包声明 YAML 解析依赖，独立发布工具将其打包为无需安装依赖的校验产物；不引入官方运行时对产品包的依赖。 产品运行时通过公开 Scope 与 MCP 资源、Node PTC 测试依赖验证连接器按需发现；只补充产品包依赖，不改官方执行循环。

Maintained bilingual integration documentation and generated API/config/slot catalogs describe the public extension points and product-owned consumers. Generated product names are documentation data only. Persistence history acknowledges source-only message attribution without changing official Session formats. Tool slot documentation is condensed without changing its contract to keep the expanded report within its existing per-slot limit when product tools register. The company content source is a private product Host service, documented by its owning package rather than projected into the official public service catalog.
Preserve the existing keyless SDK audit profile as a local validation fixture; it is neither an official profile nor a product runtime dependency.
Correct stale package references in maintained bilingual Agent Notes to the current Chat and Session Controller owners; preserve the recorded decisions.

An ordered session-maybe Hero action slot accepts independent extension controls beside the unchanged official workspace and mode controls. Entries release independently and disappear when a task starts. The owner row wraps within narrow windows; slot declarations and catalogs document the public extension point.

The public draft initializer accepts complete semantic drafts and persists successful explicit initialization before a Session scope is released. Pending submissions refuse initialization; storage failure restores the original draft. Ordinary draft edits retain the upstream mounted persistence lifecycle.

Expose a reusable root-scoped document.preview Factory for authorized non-Session sources. Reuse native document bodies without fabricated Sessions, cancel retired reads, clear inaccessible bytes, admit Office source reads through caller-owned conversion, and preserve visible XLSX rows when optional worksheet format properties are absent.
通用文档校验支持以中文作为唯一维护版本；只规范化解析出的章节标题，保留正文、代码和行号，中文模型条目生成非空锚点。翻译清单显式排除产品中文单版文档，不缩小内容检查范围。 显式非配对的持久化记录仍校验声明、快照及正文；目录索引支持没有翻译副本的单版文档。
通用桌面更新器将缺少打包更新源声明为 unavailable，不作为可重试故障或已是最新版本。侧栏隐藏不可用状态；原生提示说明当前版本及安装要求，使用紧凑横向操作布局。显式检查通过受信 IPC 进入独立下载确认；状态操作与安装确认保持官方生命周期保护。
Office 验收样本使用固定 ZIP 时间戳，确保原文件下载与稍后校验的字节一致，不改变文档预览或转换行为。
通用设置页复用 Factory：设置窗口与应用主区共享已注册页面，由唯一 Factory 持有 settings.section；弹窗打开时暂停内嵌实例，关闭后恢复；未知页面不回退。产品通过公开 Factory 和侧栏入口接入，不修改第三方插件。
记录社区专家与技能源码迁入独立产品包后的来源、许可与维护方式，测试数据单独保存，不再作为可独立安装的预装插件发布。
通用 profile 默认插入层先于用户覆盖，配置编辑器与 CLI 使用相同顺序；产品固定内建模块使用该层保存个人配置，不再保留旧插件替换机制。
Git 文件清单读取容量与其他仓库门禁统一为 64 MiB，避免正常仓库文件名总量超过 Node 默认 1 MiB 时 ENOBUFS；原有检查范围及拒绝规则不变。
通用 Remote 贡献项释放按队列顺序启动，但等待 namespace 依赖插件卸载时释放队列，避免依赖插件撤回自己持有的 Remote 贡献项时循环等待。卸载仍等待所有依赖清理结束；不更改产品协议、模型输入或 Session 格式。
原生 HTTP 请求仅携带当前 Host 的认证 Cookie，避免历次本机监听端口 Cookie 累积导致 HTTP 431；限定相同 authority 并拒绝重定向，不改变员工认证或执行循环。
将专家与技能作为产品内建模块统一装配；仅登记依赖布局、生成目录和原有源码断言门禁基线的迁移差异，不修改官方执行循环。 原社区实现迁移后沿用此前 vendor 的 lint 范围；新增配置读取、提交出口及装配测试仍由仓库 lint 检查，源码均经过独立严格类型检查。 移除已由真实 Cordis Context 测试夹具替代的产品类型断言基线条目，不扩大允许断言的范围。
完整构建的 Host 聚合检查等待 Host bundle 生成公开类型声明，避免并行检查读到尚未生成或正在替换的声明。独立检查与无 bundle 的类型检查顺序保持不变。
保留完整 ASAR 校验，报告最多十项封装差异，并使用真实 builder 遍历和 manifest 转换验证封装内容。
在封装运行时清单前剔除 ASAR 固定忽略的 .gitkeep 空目录占位文件，保留实际图标资源和全部内容完整性校验。
